changelog.summary: Adds a release- and flag-bound adoption observation to reviewed Product decision route with denominator and coverage gates.

title: Released Feature to Adoption Decision
description: Measure eligible, exposed and using accounts for a shipped feature, then prepare a bounded product owner decision.
setup_prompt: Use Released Feature to Adoption Decision as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Product Adoption Analyst and Product Feedback Coordinator Crews, the actual release/build and flag revision, exact eligible segment, identity and exposure/use rules, comparable window, predeclared target, minimum sample, coverage and current issue source. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, blocking validators, an owner-reviewed decision and a real manual case including incomplete coverage. Selecting this Playbook does not query customer data, create an issue, change a flag, message customers, launch an experiment or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, product, feature, release/build, flag revision and eligible segment
Versioned distinct-account, eligibility, exposure and use predicates and window
Predeclared use target, minimum exposed sample and coverage threshold
Authorized release, flag, eligibility, exposure, use and issue records or exports
Product owner, issue-match, action and privacy policy
Manual-only or reviewed release/analytics event and repeat route

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment

recommended_tools.purpose: Verify exact deployed build, flag revision and exposure period

pulse_focus.label: Released feature adoption
focus_areas: Eligible versus exposed versus using account counts and source coverage
Owner decisions on released features without unsupported causal claims
review_when: A complete comparable window arrives, instrumentation or flag revision changes, or an owner decision remains pending

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and source/rule map
Validated feature-adoption-decision/v1 with current issue read
Manual case, owner state and activation choice
